publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: Time zone configured, visible clock still pending
record.method: Private-data readback plus libc/CoreFoundation inspection; separate RTC initialization
record.observation: The private 7E18 time-zone configuration selects America/Sao_Paulo and passes physical installation, libc/CoreFoundation resolution and recovery checks. UTC calendar initialization is a separate step.
record.limits: The owner-visible clock hand check remains pending. A verified time-zone file does not establish every historical daylight-saving behavior or RTC drift.
record.status: Configuration and physical readback passed; owner clock check pending
